restrictions: Use exactly 55-byte messages, standard fixed-IV SHA-256 indices 0 through 30 on the single correctly padded block, full feed-forward, and all 256 digest bits.
Draw two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words per sample; mask the second to 184 bits. Generate exactly 2^128+1 messages, with no seed expansion or duplicate-rejection loop.

Use three-word records and two explicitly charged stable 128-bit radix passes, including clearing and prefix sums of the 2^128-word count array. Scan for unequal messages with equal complete digests and rehash a returned pair.

All failed executions, setup, random draws, loads/stores, addressing, instruction fetches, sorting, scanning, and final verification are inside the worst-case time bound. Memory is separately reported, not free or practical.
data_log2 bounds bytes of complete padded input hashed including verification. Actual nonuniform advice is zero; its logarithmic field is a conservative one-byte upper bound.

This is a distribution-free analytic generic construction, not an executed collision search, empirical result, differential advance, or claimed improvement over the nominal exponent 128. Qualification and promotion require fresh review.
